svg.title: Bezà daily GCC products and their seasonal midpoint transitions
svg.desc: Two panels show 2024 and 2025 smoothed GCC mean and GCC 90th percentile curves. Downward triangles mark falling T50 transitions and upward triangles mark rising T50 transitions.
